release_notes:
v1.1.2 Release - Outbound TX Boolean Fields & Dynamic Telemetry Readback Updates.

Changes:
  - Outbound TX Boolean Fields: Full support for bool/boolean data types in TX command field specifications, automatically bit-packed into 8-bit byte flags.
  - Live Telemetry Readback Labels: Parameter Editor and TX Command form fields dynamically display real-time 'Current: X' telemetry readback values.
  - Merged RX/TX Frame Definitions: Config loader support for merged RX/TX frame definitions (direction='rxtx' or duplicate frame IDs across RX/TX rows).
  - Calculations Unit Inheritance: Dynamically inherits unit configurations for statistics from matching variable group signals when not explicitly specified.
  - Prefixless Calculations Logging: Logged calculation Excel headers are now prefixless (e.g. 'Cell Voltages min (V)' instead of '0x0100.Cells avg (V)') for clean data reporting.
  - Non-Blocking Thread Shutdown: Serial worker unblocks kernel I/O calls on close to ensure instantaneous thread teardown.
